title: Checkpoint: Memory & Lifetime
prompt: Implement `long bounded_total(const long* values, int count, long cap)`: sum up to `count` values read through the pointer (stop early once the running total would exceed `cap` — in that case return `cap`). A null pointer with `count > 0`, or a negative `count`, must throw `std::invalid_argument`.

tests.name: cap
tests.hint: 50 fits; 60 would exceed → clamp at cap.

tests.name: null
tests.hint: Null with a positive count is a caller bug → throw.
